title: Enhanced sensitivity of lateral flow assay for NGAL detection using cysteamine-modified gold nanoparticles
content:

Paweena Tunakhun, Sawinee Ngernpimai, Patcharaporn Tippayawat, Kiattawee Choowongkomon, Sirirat Anutrakulchai, Nicha Charoensri, Ratree Tavichakorntrakool, Sakda Daduang, Oranee Srichaiyapol, Pornsuda Maraming, Jeerati Prompipak, Patcharee Boonsiri, Jureerut Daduang
An aggregation-based assay was developed to assess monoclonal antibody orientation on gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) for NGAL detection. Cysteamine-coated AuNPs showed better antibody orientation than citrate-coated AuNPs, improving NGAL LFS sensitivity.
